tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search the Tower of Babel public-domain library by title or creator. Results are in catalog order, not relevance-ranked; follow next_cursor until it is null to cover more of the catalog. Read-only.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Get one work's metadata by its id (artifact id, e.g. us-declaration-of-independence). Read-only.

tools.name: list_collection
tools.description: List works in one collection (PAPERS, DECLASSIFIED, BOOKS, REFERENCE, DOCUMENTS, PODCASTS) in catalog order. Follow next_cursor until null. Read-only.

tools.name: list_group
tools.description: List works in a precomputed group: a sacred tradition, a declassified programme, a top author, or a course group. Use the collections endpoint (or the library's group lists) for valid keys. Read-only.
